title.zh: 三星钱包面向美国Galaxy用户上线USDC稳定币账户
title.en: Samsung Wallet launches USDC stablecoin accounts for U.S. Galaxy users

current_state.zh: Samsung Wallet 已面向美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户上线稳定币账户，支持在 Solana 上使用 USDC，覆盖约8200万台兼容设备；该服务由 Bastion 和 Coinbase 提供托管与基础设施，支持向兼容钱包转账以及60多个国家的银行账户提现，并计划未来探索稳定币支付和更多市场。
current_state.en: Samsung Wallet has launched stablecoin accounts for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, supporting USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices; the service uses Bastion and Coinbase for custody/infrastructure, supports transfers to compatible wallets and bank payouts in 60+ countries, and Samsung plans to explore stablecoin payments and additional markets.

updates.what_changed_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin payments/holding to a mainstream consumer hardware audience.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase将把USDC设为三星Wallet美国用户默认美元稳定币，预计10月底上线
updates.title_en: Coinbase将把USDC设为三星Wallet美国用户默认美元稳定币，预计10月底上线
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase宣布，自2026年10月最后一周起，USDC将成为三星Wallet美国用户默认的美元稳定币，并通过Coinbase Prime进行合规托管（符合NYDFS要求），Bastion提供支持。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase announced that from the last week of October 2026, USDC will become the default dollar stablecoin for US users of Samsung Wallet, with custody via Coinbase Prime under NYDFS-compliant qualified custody, supported by Bastion.
updates.current_state_zh: 三星Wallet将于10月底添加Sui上的USDC，并使其成为美国用户默认美元稳定币；托管由Bastion和Coinbase Prime（NYDFS合规）提供，并在60多个国家支持银行账户转账。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October and make it the default dollar stablecoin for US users; custody is provided by Bastion and Coinbase Prime (NYDFS-compliant), with bank-account transfers in more than 60 countries.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coinbase announced that USDC will become the default dollar stablecoin for US users of Samsung Wallet from the last week of October 2026, with custody via Coinbase Prime and NYDFS-compliant qualified custody, supported by Bastion.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase announced that USDC will become the default dollar stablecoin for US users of Samsung Wallet from the last week of October 2026, with custody via Coinbase Prime and NYDFS-compliant qualified custody, supported by Bastion.

updates.title_zh: 三星钱包将于10月为美国Galaxy用户添加USDC转账功能
updates.title_en: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for US Galaxy users in October
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充：USDC 转账功能将允许美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户向兼容钱包发送 USDC，并通过 Bastion 基础设施在 60 多个国家提现至银行账户；覆盖美国 8200 万台兼容 Galaxy 设备，用户需完成身份验证；Solana 和 Sui 被列为技术合作伙伴；向外部钱包转账免手续费，国际银行转账收费因目的地和金额而异；Borderless.xyz 负责 60 多国的支付；未来可能支持线上和店内稳定币支付。
updates.what_changed_en: New report adds: USDC transfers will let eligible US Galaxy users send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts in 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure; available on 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US with identity verification; Solana and Sui named as technical partners; no fee for USDC transfers to external wallets, international bank transfers incur fees varying by destination and amount; Borderless.xyz handles payouts in 60+ countries; future online and in-store stablecoin payments may follow.
updates.current_state_zh: 三星Wallet将于2026年10月底添加Sui上的USDC，并使其成为美国用户默认美元稳定币；将支持向兼容钱包发送USDC并通过Bastion基础设施在60多个国家提现至银行账户；托管由Bastion和Coinbase Prime（NYDFS合规）提供；覆盖美国8200万台兼容Galaxy设备，用户需身份验证；Solana和Sui为技术合作伙伴；对外部钱包转账免手续费，国际银行转账收费；未来可能支持线上和店内稳定币支付。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October 2026 and make it the default dollar stablecoin for US users; it will enable USDC transfers to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts in 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure; custody is provided by Bastion and Coinbase Prime (NYDFS-compliant); available on 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US with identity verification; Solana and Sui are technical partners; no fee for transfers to external wallets, international bank transfers incur fees; future online and in-store stablecoin payments may follow.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung will enable USDC transfers in Samsung Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users in the last week of October, letting them send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts across 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure with Coinbase as sub-custodian.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung will enable USDC transfers in Samsung Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users in the last week of October, letting them send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts across 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure with Coinbase as sub-custodian.

updates.title_zh: 三星钱包将为美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户提供稳定币访问
updates.title_en: Samsung Wallet to Bring Stablecoin Access to Eligible Galaxy Users in the US
updates.what_changed_zh:
三星宣布，Samsung Wallet 将为美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户提供稳定币访问，把美元支持的加密资产带给主流智能手机用户群体。相关报道将该功能描述为支持 USDC，使美国 Galaxy 用户可以将资金转入银行账户和加密钱包，并计划未来扩展到更多国家。

此举通过一家全球大型设备厂商，把美元支持的稳定币直接呈现在大众智能手机用户面前，形成了一条与加密原生应用和交易所不同的消费者触达渠道。

该消息停留在标题层面的承诺；有关此次整合的报道指出，稳定币发行方、完整支持代币清单等多项实施细节尚未披露。搜索摘录还提到，该功能初期仅面向美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户，未来将扩展至更多国家。
updates.what_changed_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.current_state_zh:
三星宣布，Samsung Wallet 将为美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户提供稳定币访问，把美元支持的加密资产带给主流智能手机用户群体。相关报道将该功能描述为支持 USDC，使美国 Galaxy 用户可以将资金转入银行账户和加密钱包，并计划未来扩展到更多国家。

此举通过一家全球大型设备厂商，把美元支持的稳定币直接呈现在大众智能手机用户面前，形成了一条与加密原生应用和交易所不同的消费者触达渠道。

该消息停留在标题层面的承诺；有关此次整合的报道指出，稳定币发行方、完整支持代币清单等多项实施细节尚未披露。搜索摘录还提到，该功能初期仅面向美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户，未来将扩展至更多国家。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.background_zh: 稳定币是一种旨在相对于某一参考资产（最常见的是美元等法定货币）保持价值稳定的加密货币，依靠储备资产或算法机制实现，但顾名思义，稳定币并不总能维持锚定。Samsung Wallet 是三星在 Galaxy 设备上的移动钱包，此前主要用于支付卡、票券与数字钥匙，而非加密资产转账。随着交易规模上升，稳定币的发行与使用在全球各地日益受到监管关注。
updates.background_en: A stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency designed to maintain a stable value relative to a reference asset, most commonly a fiat currency such as the US dollar, using reserve assets or algorithmic mechanisms; despite the name, stablecoins have not always held their peg. Samsung Wallet is Samsung's mobile wallet on Galaxy devices, which has primarily handled payment cards, passes and keys rather than crypto transfers. Stablecoin issuance and usage have increasingly drawn regulatory attention across jurisdictions as transaction volumes have grown.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是消费者分发与托管：在一款大众市场的手机厂商钱包中嵌入美元稳定币转账，可能拓宽美元稳定币的零售入口，并使部分点对点支付流量从加密原生应用分流，实际影响规模取决于最终支持的代币、费用与覆盖地区。受影响最直接的板块包括美元稳定币发行方、争夺同一 Galaxy 用户群的移动钱包与支付服务商，以及三星自身的设备服务生态。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is consumer distribution and custody: embedding dollar stablecoin transfers in a mass-market OEM wallet could widen the retail on-ramp for dollar stablecoins and shift some peer-to-peer payment flows away from crypto-native apps, with the scale of any effect depending on which tokens, fees and geographies are ultimately supported. Segments most directly exposed are dollar stablecoin issuers, mobile wallet and payments providers competing for the same Galaxy user base, and Samsung's own device-services ecosystem.

updates.title_zh: 三星钱包在 Solana 上支持 USDC，稳定币走向主流
updates.title_en: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
updates.what_changed_zh: Samsung Wallet 的稳定币账户已在美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户中上线，支持在 Solana 上买卖、持有、发送和接收 USDC；此前状态仍为10月宣布的待上线计划。新报道还补充了信用卡充值4%手续费、纽约州不可用、Android 13及以上、25美元USDC新手奖励等实施细节。
updates.what_changed_en: Samsung Wallet stablecoin accounts went live for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, supporting buy, hold, send, and receive of USDC on Solana; the prior state was an announced plan expected in late October. The report also adds implementation details: 4% credit-card top-up fee, unavailable in New York, Android 13+, and a $25 USDC new-user bonus.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung Wallet launched stablecoin accounts for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, enabling fee-free buy, hold, send and receive of USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices via custodian Bastion and Coinbase, with bank payouts in over 60 countries.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung Wallet launched stablecoin accounts for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, enabling fee-free buy, hold, send and receive of USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices via custodian Bastion and Coinbase, with bank payouts in over 60 countries.
